note: Both sets capture the controller goals, operating ranges, filter type and variable definitions accurately, with quotes that support the claims. Set B additionally captures two important facts Set A omits: that generator speed measurement is the sole feedback input for both controllers, and that no nacelle-yaw control actions were developed. Set A's extra claims are largely a restatement of the nonpower-production fact under a second entity name plus a near-trivial design-basis claim, while Set B's weakness is repeating the feedback-input fact twice per controller with only differing conditions.
remarks: Set A states the nonpower-production fact twice (bound to 'NREL 5-MW wind turbine' and to 'NREL 5-MW baseline control system') and the filter-type fact twice with different conditions; Set B repeats each feedback-input claim twice per controller. Neither set extracts the filter equations (7-1, 7-2) or the definitions of alpha, Ts and fc, which are the main quantitative content of Section 7.1.
